Most students respect teachers’ personal choices. - **Energy vs. Time:** If you’re already juggling lesson planning, grading, and extracurriculars, ensure this routine doesn’t add unnecessary stress. If it’s something you *enjoy* and it doesn’t drain you, it’s a win. ### **Why It’s "Right":** Your approach aligns with **self-respect, professionalism, and emotional well-being**—all of which are positive traits for a teacher. Many educators prioritize their appearance or hobbies as a way to recharge, and your routine sounds like a healthy, intentional habit. **Final Verdict:** **1 (right)**—you’re doing nothing wrong, and in many ways, you’re setting a great example of balancing personal care with professional responsibility. Keep doing what makes you feel confident and put-together! 🌟
